entries.angle: A month after the paper reported OpenAI shelving its IPO, its main rival heads the other way and invites investors to talk about a listing, so the two frontier labs are now funding themselves by opposite routes (public market versus private mega-round), with the 14 October meeting as the next date to watch.
entries.headline: Anthropic傳準備上市，估值可能近2兆美元

entries.angle: A brand-new thread for the paper: global health treated as institutional resilience, as the world's main health-policy forum opens with a Lancet Commission verdict on what the next century's threats are.
entries.headline: 世界衛生高峰會今天在柏林登場

entries.angle: A new Chicago thread, away from the paper's recent budget, housing, labour and transit entries: the city's biggest single-day event, seen as a 26.2-mile tour through its neighbourhoods and a measure of its economic draw.
entries.headline: 芝加哥馬拉松今天開跑，跑過29個社區

entries.angle: A new policy thread: the federal-Illinois standoff moves to disaster relief, where a third straight FEMA denial shifts storm-recovery costs from Washington onto counties and households, and turns a technical damage threshold into a political lever.
entries.headline: 聯邦政府第三次拒絕伊州救災申請

entries.angle: A game-day stakes lens rather than another quarterback-injury bulletin: a 3-1 Bears team walks into the 214th meeting with first place in the NFC North in play, and the oldest rivalry in the league tests whether the hot start is real.
entries.headline: 熊隊今天到蘭博球場，挑戰老對手包裝工

entries.angle: Day-one result after a week of Leeds previews (6 Oct opponent profile, 8 Oct Arteta press conference, 9 Oct injury news): what happened when a nearly full-strength Arsenal met an unbeaten Leeds, and where that leaves the title defence after the Brighton defeat.
entries.headline: 兵工廠逆轉里茲聯，積分追平曼城

entries.angle: The AI-bubble question moves from investors and the labs' own fundraising to the world's financial firefighters: the IMF and World Bank open their annual meetings with AI-driven debt and market concentration formally on the financial-stability agenda.
entries.headline: 世界財經大會在曼谷開幕，AI泡沫成焦點

entries.angle: Nobel week ends with the one prize closest to this paper's identity: what the economics committee chose to reward, and what that says about which economic ideas matter now.
entries.headline: 諾貝爾經濟學獎今天公布，誰會得獎？

entries.angle: The 11 Oct game-day stakes preview gets its answer: whether a Bagent-led Bears team won at Lambeau as favourites and what that says about whether the 3-1 start is real without Williams.
entries.headline: 熊隊在綠灣大敗，7比31輸給包裝工

entries.angle: The beat turns from the Premier League to Europe for the first time since the Napoli result: the first Champions League home night of the season, and how Arteta rotates a squad that has only just got healthy.
entries.headline: 兵工廠明天迎戰里爾，歐冠首場主場戰

entries.angle: The 12 October preview gets its answer: the committee rewards the theory inside every central bank's playbook (expectations, forward guidance, sticky prices) in the same year the paper has watched the Fed, BOJ and RBA use that playbook against a war-driven inflation shock.
entries.headline: 美國兩位學者拿下諾貝爾經濟學獎

entries.angle: A new mechanism in the paper's run of executive-power stories: public money spent on pre-election ads, and a court order the government appears to have ignored the morning after it was issued. This differs from the 28 September pocket-rescission and 8 October Medicare-cheque entries, which were about withholding or handing out money, not government advertising.
entries.headline: 法官叫停政府用稅金打的電視廣告

entries.angle: Yesterday's piece covered the opening of the meetings and AI as a financial-stability risk. Today the IMF puts numbers on what the war-driven energy shock and tightening wave are doing to growth country by country, which is the first scoreboard of 2026's damage.
entries.headline: IMF：今年全球經濟成長3.1%

entries.angle: Arteta called Saliba fit on 8 October, and now a specialist has found a back injury. The story is a diagnosis and a choice between two return dates (Everton in the league, or a lower-risk cup tie at Fleetwood), not a result, a preview or a transfer target.
entries.headline: 薩利巴背傷不用開刀，最快月底回來

entries.angle: On 12 October AI-bubble risk was only an agenda item at the IMF meetings. Now the IMF's own financial-stability report puts hard numbers on it (S&P 500 valuations above 96% of readings since 1990, tech concentration above dotcom levels) and names what would set off a correction: AI failing to pay off in earnings or productivity.
entries.headline: IMF警告：AI股價太高，可能突然大跌

entries.angle: The investor meeting the paper flagged on 11 October as 'the next date to watch' has now happened, and the listing has a calendar (roadshow around 9 November, trading before Thanksgiving) and named lead banks. The day after the IMF warned AI stocks are overvalued, the first frontier-lab IPO is the real test of that warning.
entries.headline: Anthropic辦投資人日，準備上市

entries.angle: Two rebuilding programs meet: Penn State is in its first season after firing a long-serving coach, and Whittingham's year-one Michigan is trying to fix its turnovers at home. This is about the shape of two rebuilds, not a single coaching duel like the 25 September Ferentz preview, and differs from the 4 October Little Brown Jug loss and 22 September fumble entries.
entries.headline: 兩位新教練對決，密西根返校日迎戰賓州州立

entries.angle: The answer to the 12 October Lille preview: the European record that is building quietly beside an uneven league defence. Fourteen straight Champions League wins, with the goals coming from Timber, Eze and Saka rather than a centre-forward, which matters for the striker-shortage story the beat has followed since September.
entries.headline: 七分鐘進三球，兵工廠歐冠十四連勝

entries.angle: The quarterback-health story finally turns to a return: after a month of strain, MRI, 'week-to-week' and two Bagent starts ending in the Lambeau rout, Williams is expected back at Atlanta. The question shifts from whether the team can survive without him to whether his return can repair the damage from Green Bay.
entries.headline: 熊隊四分衛威廉斯可望復出

entries.angle: The beat swings back from Europe to the league. It asks whether Arsenal's flawless European form can carry into an away league match, where their title defence has been uneven, sitting between the Forest trip and Bayern four days later.
entries.headline: 兵工廠作客諾丁漢森林

entries.angle: The IPO gets its first hard numbers: the 15 Oct entry gave a calendar and a valuation rumour, and now the disclosed revenue, profits and slowing quarter-on-quarter growth let the reader test the IMF's overvaluation warning against an actual income statement, a $1.5tn-versus-$2tn argument about growth rates rather than hype.
entries.headline: Anthropic第三季收入大增，上市估值引發爭論

entries.angle: The 29 Sept story was a civil war spilling into Afar with vague accusations against neighbours; now it has become a state-against-state confrontation, with broken diplomatic ties, Eritrean troops reported inside Tigray and Ethiopian drone strikes, all driven by landlocked Ethiopia's demand for a Red Sea port.
entries.headline: 衣索比亞與厄利垂亞走到戰爭邊緣

entries.angle: The injury story moves from the quarterback to the defence: just as Williams is cleared to return, the unit that gave up 31 points at Lambeau loses a starting linebacker, its top edge signing and possibly both starting corners, so the question is no longer whether the QB plays but whether a depleted defence can support him.
entries.headline: 熊隊威廉斯可能回歸，防守球員卻接連受傷

entries.angle: The beat's first individual-player profile of the season: Saka's change from creator to scorer, set against the striker shortage the beat has followed since September, is a player-feature lens that differs from 16 Oct's Forest fixture preview and 15 Oct's Lille result.
entries.headline: 薩卡越來越會進球

entries.angle: The consumption gap the paper described on 15 Sept and tested through Golden Week spending on 2 Oct now gets its quarterly verdict: growth beats forecasts and stays on target, but almost entirely through exports and factories while households and investment keep shrinking, so China is hitting its number the old way.
entries.headline: 中國第三季經濟成長4.5%，比預期好

entries.angle: After three IPO entries about valuation, calendar and income statement (11, 15 and 17 Oct), the story turns to governance: the first frontier lab to go public writes a share pledge into its structure that grows as the company's value rises and is barred from lobbying, raising the question of who a public AI company answers to besides its shareholders.
entries.headline: Anthropic拿出5%股份做公益

entries.angle: The 2 Oct weekend preview gets its follow-up at a new stage: the first-round result put the challenger ahead of a sitting president, and the first head-to-head debate shows a Bolsonaro comeback, through the son, as the favourite a week before the runoff.
entries.headline: 巴西選總統，兩人電視辯論互罵

entries.angle: A new thread for the paper: the energy-and-rates shock the paper has tracked through oil prices, diesel and the IMF's growth figures now shows up as street unrest in several European countries, with Milan as the flashpoint.
entries.headline: 米蘭物價抗議連續兩天變暴力

entries.angle: The month-long quarterback-health story ends with an answer: Williams is back and sharp, completing 30 of 36, and the depleted defence the paper worried about on 17 Oct nearly gives the lead away before making the play that saves the game.
entries.headline: 威廉斯傷好回歸，熊隊31比23勝獵鷹

entries.angle: The 16 Oct preview asked whether Arsenal's European form would carry into an uneven away league record; the answer is a narrow, low-quality win, with one shot on target and a substitute's deflected goal, which points again to the forward shortage the beat has followed since September.
entries.headline: 兵工廠1比0小勝森林

entries.angle: A new Chicago labor story, different from 8 Oct's Obama Foundation union drive: a public education system shuts down mid-semester, and AI job protection is a formal bargaining demand, so the AI-and-jobs question shows up in a Chicago union contract rather than in national data.
entries.headline: 芝加哥城市學院清晨談成合約，罷工喊停

entries.angle: The federal campaign over voter eligibility moves from rules and records (the 26 Sept Supreme Court voter-roll ruling, the 9 Oct story on immigration enforcement mining voter data) to a lawsuit asking a court to stop ballots already cast from being counted.
entries.headline: 司法部緊急求法官：加州兩萬張選票先別算

entries.angle: A new economics-of-ideas story: a well-known economist argues that the standard fiscal sum on immigration is built wrong because it treats immigrants as line items in a budget rather than as trading partners.
entries.headline: 考文：算移民的帳，別忘了「交易的好處」

entries.angle: A back-pages way into Brazil a week before the runoff: the country seen through what it eats and how that food is made, not through its presidential candidates.
entries.headline: 考文吃遍巴西：最愛米納斯的豆子

entries.angle: The first regular-season game of the new coach's era, previewed as what a rebuild should be judged on. Different from the camp story (29 Sept), preseason-opener preview (7 Oct), rookie matchup (9 Oct), and Memphis preseason result (10 Oct).
entries.headline: 公牛明晚開季，新教練首戰暴龍

entries.angle: What comes next: a Champions League winning run meets its hardest opponent of the group stage (if Bayern is confirmed) — a different lens from 19 Oct's Forest win, 17 Oct's Saka profile, and 15 Oct's Lille result.
entries.headline: 兵工廠明天作客慕尼黑，挑戰拜仁

entries.angle: Three weeks after Trump turned down Tehran's ceasefire offer, the diplomacy has moved backwards: Washington is now openly pessimistic, ships in Hormuz are under attack again, and Iran is visibly moving closer to Moscow, so this is no longer a two-sided war but a lineup with Russia standing behind Tehran.
entries.headline: 美國說和伊朗談和「非常困難」

entries.angle: A new thread for the paper: Israel's 27 October election, which could end Netanyahu's time in power, seen through an unannounced visit from the US defence secretary a week before the vote, which raises the question of Washington's stake in the result.
entries.headline: 以色列大選前，美國國防部長突然到訪

entries.angle: The pressure on Kyiv now comes from Washington rather than Moscow: Trump openly blames Zelensky for the war, while Russia sends a message in orbit by moving a satellite close to the commercial radar satellites Ukraine's backers rely on. This differs from 21 Sept's Moscow refinery strike and 24 Sept's UN ceasefire coalition.
entries.headline: 川普怪澤倫斯基「不想結束戰爭」

entries.angle: A new international thread for the paper: a NATO state on the front line by the Black Sea finally has a government after months of deadlock, which adds to the paper's European political checks after Latvia (4 Oct) and the cost-of-living protests (19 Oct).
entries.headline: 羅馬尼亞新政府上任，結束五個月僵局

entries.angle: A quarterback-change story, which the beat has not used before: the turnover problem the paper has followed since 22 Sept costs the five-star starter his job, and a freshman with a Michigan coaching family name gets his first start on the road against a top-10 team.
entries.headline: 密西根換四分衛？大一新生卡爾可能先發

entries.angle: A team-sheet comparison on match day, not a repeat of 20 Oct's 'hardest opponent' framing: both clubs arrive missing key players (Arsenal without Saliba and Hincapie, Bayern without Olise and Musiala and possibly Neuer), and Zubimendi's return reshapes the midfield.
entries.headline: 兵工廠今天挑戰拜仁，兩隊都缺主力

entries.angle: A new business thread for the paper: a carmaker whose car sales are shrinking asks investors to value it as an AI and robotics company, and Q3 margins show how much the old business can still pay for the new bet.
entries.headline: 特斯拉第三季賺得變少

entries.angle: A new back-pages ideas thread: an economist measures what campus shootings do to survivors' lives years later and finds students still graduate on time but fewer go on to further study.
entries.headline: 校園槍擊對學生的長期影響

entries.angle: A forward-looking schedule lens rather than another quarterback-health story: a short-week home game against the Patriots is the last chance to bank a win before the NFC North run decides the season.
entries.headline: 熊隊今晚主場迎戰愛國者

entries.angle: After two days of previews (20 Oct hardest-opponent framing, 21 Oct team-sheet comparison), the day-one result: whether Arsenal's 14-match European winning run survived the hardest away trip of the league phase.
entries.headline: 兵工廠客場2比2逼和拜仁

entries.angle: A market-verdict preview: the betting line says Michigan is a clear underdog against a one-loss Indiana that nearly beat Ohio State, showing how far the old Big Ten order has flipped. Distinct from prior QB-change and Penn State preview stories.
entries.headline: 密西根主場迎戰印第安納

entries.angle: The Saliba return decision is now 48 hours away, framed as a preview of Saturday's Everton match: after playing without him at Bayern, does Arteta risk him in the league or ease him in at the Fleetwood cup tie? Distinct from the Bayern result story and the earlier injury-diagnosis story.
entries.headline: 薩利巴快回來了

entries.angle: On the eve of the vote, the race the paper called a Bolsonaro comeback on 19 Oct has tightened into a toss-up, so the piece is about what each result would mean for Brazil (a convicted ex-president's family back in power, or a Lula fourth term) rather than another debate or poll recap.
entries.headline: 巴西明天選總統，兩人幾乎打平

entries.angle: Day one of the result after the 22 Oct schedule preview: whether the Bears banked the win before the NFC North run, and whether Williams' return held up in his second game back with a short-handed defence.
entries.headline: 熊隊30比24打敗愛國者隊

entries.angle: Day-one result of the Everton match the 23 Oct entry previewed: a clean, comfortable home win after the scrappy 1-0 at Forest and the 2-2 at Bayern, with attention now on cup rotation at Fleetwood and the 1 Nov trip to Liverpool, the hardest league test of the autumn.
entries.headline: Arsenal 2-0 Everton

entries.angle: The 24 Oct eve-of-vote toss-up gets its answer: Lula wins a narrow fourth term, and the story is now whether Brazil's institutions hold as the losing side refuses to concede and goes after the Supreme Court's voting-hours extension.
entries.headline: 盧拉小勝當選巴西總統，對手不認輸

entries.angle: The AI-bubble story moves from the sellers (the Anthropic IPO's valuation, revenue and governance on 11, 15, 17 and 19 Oct) to the buyers: ordinary large companies are not yet showing any financial return, which is the trigger the IMF warned about on 14 Oct.
entries.headline: 經濟學家：多數大公司還沒從 AI 賺到錢

entries.angle: The eve of the vote, through the numbers: final polls show neither bloc reaching 61 seats, so the piece explains why Israel's result will come from post-election coalition maths rather than the vote itself. This differs from 21 Oct's US-visit angle.
entries.headline: 以色列明天投票，兩邊都難過半

entries.angle: A new ideas thread for the paper: small, fast grants to unusual young people in India, from manuscript preservation to grassroots AI tools. This is a talent-spotting lens, different from the paper's earlier Cowen entries on immigration (20 Oct) and Brazilian food (20 Oct).
entries.headline: 小獎金找印度奇才：祭司工程師救古書

entries.angle: The basketball season arrives on the sports desk for the first time, after weeks of Bears, Bulls and Michigan football: the defending champions' first test against an elite opponent in a preseason exhibition.
entries.headline: 密西根男籃熱身賽66比83輸休士頓

entries.angle: The tightening wave the paper last saw from Australia (28 Sept) reaches the big three at once: the Fed, ECB and BOJ all decide within 48 hours, and the piece compares them side by side. It asks whether a war-driven inflation shock is still pushing rates up in Washington, Frankfurt and Tokyo, and why each bank faces a different trade-off.
entries.headline: 三大央行同一週決定利率

entries.angle: Final-week stakes seen from the reader's own ballot: national polls point to a Democratic wave, and in Illinois that means an open Senate seat, House races, the first fully elected Chicago School Board, and a mail-ballot deadline tomorrow. This differs from 8 Oct's Medicare-cheque eligibility story.
entries.headline: 期中選舉剩六天，伊州郵寄選票明天截止申請

entries.angle: The new coach's era opens with two straight losses, so tonight's home game against the Knicks is framed as a bounce-back test for the rebuild. This differs from the camp story (29 Sept), the preseason entries (7, 9 and 10 Oct) and the opener preview (20 Oct).
entries.headline: 公牛連輸兩場，今晚主場迎戰尼克

entries.angle: Day-one result of the cup tie: how a rotated Arsenal side handled the lowest-ranked team left in the competition, and whether Saliba's planned return and the academy players came through it before the Liverpool trip. This differs from 25 Oct's Everton result and the 13 and 23 Oct Saliba-return entries.
entries.headline: 兵工廠輸給第四級球隊，聯賽盃出局

entries.angle: The AI-bubble story turns to the companies selling compute. After the IMF's overvaluation warning (14 Oct), the Anthropic IPO entries (11-19 Oct) and the finding that ordinary companies see no return yet (26 Oct), Google Cloud's fastest growth in years is the first hard sign that the $800B capex wave is bringing in revenue for the hyperscalers that sell AI compute, even if their customers aren't profiting yet.
entries.headline: 谷歌雲端收入翻倍，AI投資開始回本

entries.angle: The 27 Oct three-central-banks preview gets its first answer. The Fed decides whether September's surprise hike was a one-off or the start of a tightening run, and the Chair's language shows how Washington weighs war-driven inflation against a slowing economy a week before the midterms.
entries.headline: 聯準會決定不升息，兩人投反對票

entries.angle: Chicago transit seen through ageing infrastructure and service disruption: a single river bridge took out two 'L' lines for over a week and ran late. This differs from 6 Oct's Metra battery-train technology entry.
entries.headline: 湖街橋完工，綠線和粉紅線恢復行駛

entries.angle: A contender-test lens rather than another quarterback-health or result story: for the first time this season the Bears face the defending champion, so the question is whether a 5-2 start built partly on soft opponents is real. This differs from 22 Oct's short-week schedule preview and 24 Oct's Patriots result.
entries.headline: 熊隊碰上冠軍海鷹隊，是真強還是運氣好？

entries.angle: The hardest league trip of the autumn, now without Saka. The player the beat profiled on 17 Oct as Arsenal's answer to the striker shortage is injured, so the question is where the goals come from at Anfield days after the League Cup embarrassment. This differs from 28 Oct's cup-exit result and 25 Oct's Everton win.
entries.headline: 少了薩卡，兵工廠要去利物浦搶分

entries.angle: A bounce-back preview after the Indiana overtime loss (a result the paper never printed): can Whittingham's first-year rebuild steady itself against a struggling Rutgers side it is favoured to beat? This differs from 23 Oct's betting-line underdog preview, 21 Oct's quarterback change and 15 Oct's two-rebuilds Penn State preview.
entries.headline: 密西根萬聖節出戰羅格斯，想找回信心

entries.angle: A new diplomacy thread for the paper: Washington hosts the world's foreign ministers ahead of the Miami summit, and Lavrov's presence (or absence) on American soil tests the Trump administration's pressure on Kyiv that the paper covered on 21 Oct.
entries.headline: 拉夫羅夫來到亞特蘭大，G20取消大合照

entries.angle: The 26 Oct preview said the result would come from coalition maths, and now the maths is visible: Eisenkot rules out serving under Netanyahu and Arab parties emerge as possible kingmakers, raising the chance of another election.
entries.headline: 以色列大選沒人過半，阿拉伯政黨成關鍵

entries.angle: A new AI thread, away from the paper's month of AI-money stories (the Anthropic IPO, the IMF bubble warning, Google Cloud revenue): whether AI models actually reason well, shown by a specific case where a model treats a counterargument as support for the claim it was meant to challenge.
entries.headline: AI聽到反對理由，反而更相信原本的答案

entries.angle: The answer to the 30 Oct bounce-back preview: the freshman quarterback the paper first named on 21 Oct wins a tight game with his own legs late on, so the story is about Carr himself, not the turnover problems or the betting line.
entries.headline: 新人四分衛跑出致勝分，密西根28比21贏羅格斯

entries.angle: Match-day stakes and history rather than squad news: this is framed as a possible early title decider against a rival who must win, with Arsenal's 14-year wait for a league win at Anfield as the hurdle. This differs from 29 Oct's 'where do the goals come from without Saka' preview and 28 Oct's cup-exit result.
entries.headline: 兵工廠今天客場挑戰利物浦，冠軍之戰提早開打

entries.angle: Election eve at national scale: what is mathematically needed to flip each chamber and what divided government would mean for the second half of the term. The 28 Oct entry looked at the reader's own Illinois ballot and the mail-ballot deadline; the 8 Oct entry covered the Medicare-cheque eligibility rules.
entries.headline: 美國期中選舉明天登場，國會控制權成焦點

entries.angle: The AI-money story turns to the private-funding side: OpenAI's private round is shrinking just as Anthropic goes public. First sign of investor pushback at a frontier lab.
entries.headline: OpenAI找錢目標縮小，投資人變冷淡

entries.angle: A new thread for the paper: the governor's race, seen as a historic third term and a launch pad for national ambitions.
entries.headline: 伊州明天投票，普立茲克拚第三任

entries.angle: Day-one result of the title-decider preview. Also answers where the goals come from without Saka: Havertz ends the 14-year Anfield wait and opens a 9-point gap a week after the Fleetwood embarrassment.
entries.headline: 兵工廠1比0贏利物浦，14年來第一次

entries.angle: Election Day through one marquee race: whether a Democrat can win statewide in Texas for the first time in three decades, and what a Paxton loss would mean for Senate control. This differs from 2 Nov's national seat-maths overview, 28 Oct's Illinois-ballot entry and 8 Oct's Medicare-cheque entry.
entries.headline: 德州參議員大戰，民主黨拚三十年來首勝

entries.angle: A full piece on Chicago's ballot that is about governance rather than horse-race politics: after 30 years of mayoral control, voters take over the country's fourth-largest school district, and the board they elect inherits a budget hole. The 28 Oct entry only listed the board race as one item on the Illinois ballot, and 2 Nov covered the governor's race.
entries.headline: 芝加哥第一次全民選出教育委員會

entries.angle: The federal campaign over elections reaches the polling place itself: federal observers on the ground on Election Day, after the paper covered voter-roll rules (26 Sept), voter-data mining (9 Oct) and a suit to stop counting cast ballots (20 Oct).
entries.headline: 司法部派千名觀察員到投票所

entries.angle: The federal-Illinois standoff moves to the ballot box: Chicago asks its own voters to endorse demanding money back from Washington, after the 11 Oct FEMA disaster-aid denial entry.
entries.headline: 芝加哥公投：要不要向聯邦討錢？

entries.angle: Day-one result of the 29 Oct contender-test preview: whether the Bears' 5-2 start held up against the defending champion on the road in prime time. This differs from 24 Oct's Patriots result and the earlier quarterback-health entries.
entries.headline: 熊隊34比17大勝上季冠軍海鷹

entries.angle: What comes next after the Anfield win: the first test of the 9-point lead is a midweek European match, with Arteta's latest word on Saka's return and squad rotation. This differs from 2 Nov's Liverpool result, 1 Nov's title-decider preview and 29 Oct's 'goals without Saka' framing.
entries.headline: 沒有薩卡，兵工廠週三出戰歐冠

entries.angle: The 2 Nov seat-maths preview gets its answer for the House: Democrats flip about 29 seats and take the majority, and the story is what divided government means in practice (oversight, spending fights, a stalled agenda) for the rest of Trump's term.
entries.headline: 民主黨拿下美國眾議院

entries.angle: The Senate seen through one upset: the defeat of Susan Collins, a long-serving Republican moderate, shows how far the wave reached and decides who controls the chamber that confirms judges and cabinet officials. This is separate from the House result and the 3 Nov Texas-race preview.
entries.headline: 緬因州爆冷門，柯林斯落選

entries.angle: The 3 Nov governance piece gets its answer: the first elected board president is a labor- and Preckwinkle-backed incumbent, which says who now controls the country's fourth-largest school district and how it is likely to handle the budget hole.
entries.headline: 芝加哥首次選出教育委員會主席

entries.angle: The reader's own ballot, decided: the 28 Oct Illinois-ballot entry gets its results (Stratton to the Senate, Miller in IL-2), with Chicago's ballot shortages and strong turnout as a short local note on how the vote actually went.
entries.headline: 史特拉頓可望當選伊州參議員

entries.angle: The title defence begins: after the 26 Oct exhibition loss to Houston, a first look at the new rotation (Gayle, McKenny and freshman Costello) that must face No. 2 UConn on Friday in a rematch of the championship game.
entries.headline: 密西根開季獲勝，星期五再戰康大

entries.angle: The $1.5tn-versus-$2tn debate the paper set out on 17 Oct is now being settled by the buyers themselves: in the run-up to the roadshow, investors are using the Q3 slowdown to force the price down, the schedule has slipped a week, and this is the first real-money test of the IMF's 14 Oct overvaluation warning.
entries.headline: Anthropic上市估值可能降到1.5兆美元

entries.angle: The tightening wave reaches a fourth major central bank. London has a divided committee and a fragile fiscal position, so its choice between holding and hiking shows how hard the war-driven inflation trade-off is for a mid-sized open economy.
entries.headline: 英國央行今天決定利率，市場預料升息

entries.angle: The European unrest the paper first saw as street protests in Milan (19 Oct) now takes an organised, institutional form in France: a coordinated union strike against a government budget.
entries.headline: 法國五大工會今天全國大罷工

entries.angle: A 'rematch in name only' lens: with a new head coach and only 3 of 10 starters left from April's final, the piece is about how quickly a college champion is taken apart and rebuilt in the transfer-portal era.
entries.headline: 兵工廠客場2比1險勝布拉格斯拉維亞

entries.angle: The 3 Nov 'what comes next without Saka' preview gets its answer: the Premier League lead survives its first midweek Champions League test, and once again a midfielder (Merino) provides the goals.
entries.headline: Arsenal thrash Slavia Prague 3-0 in Champions League, Merino scores twice

entries.angle: Yesterday's preview (5 Nov) said markets expected London to hike; today's answer is that the tightening wave pauses at its fourth major central bank, with a divided committee choosing to wait for the Chancellor's Budget, which makes this a story about monetary policy deferring to fiscal policy.
entries.headline: 英國央行升息到4%

entries.angle: A rivalry lens the beat hasn't used: the in-state game for the Paul Bunyan Trophy, where Michigan is a heavy favourite for once after weeks of underdog and bounce-back framing, so the question is whether a year-one rebuild can win the game that matters most to its own fans.
entries.headline: Game of the week: 5 things to know about Michigan-Michigan State

entries.angle: An opponent-and-trap lens after the big wins: the first league match since the Anfield win, at home to a Hull side that should be beaten, framed as the kind of fixture where title leads get dropped, with Rice against a leaky defence as the tactical key.
entries.headline: Arsenal vs Hull City Preview: Team news, injury updates and prediction

entries.angle: Why the result happened, seen through one mechanism: a strategy to secure the House by redrawing maps backfired in the courts, at the ballot box and through California's counter-move. This differs from the 4 Nov House-result and Collins entries, 3 Nov's Texas preview, 2 Nov's seat-maths preview, 28 Oct's Illinois-ballot entry and 8 Oct's Medicare-cheque entry.
entries.headline: 共和黨重畫選區，結果沒有幫上忙

entries.angle: Saliba's comeback moves from forecasts (the 13 Oct diagnosis with two possible return dates, then the 23 Oct 'return is 48 hours away' preview, which did not happen) to concrete milestones: full training, a first matchday-squad place and a scheduled MRI. Today's Hull match is the first chance for him to actually play. This differs from 6 Nov's Hull opponent-and-trap preview and 5 Nov's Slavia result.
entries.headline: Saliba back in Arsenal first-team training and matchday squad after back injury; Arteta hopeful of return within weeks

entries.angle: The overvaluation the IMF warned about on 14 Oct shows up in actual prices: after a month of entries on single companies (the Anthropic IPO, Google Cloud revenue, OpenAI's shrinking round), the whole AI trade is repriced at once, with about $1tn wiped off in a week.
entries.headline: AI股大跌，市值一週少了2.5兆美元

entries.angle: A new thread for the paper: the US-China chip truce reaches its one-year expiry, which shows how much of the AI hardware supply chain rests on a temporary political deal.
entries.headline: 美國延長對中國晶片管制的暫停期

entries.angle: A new world thread for the paper: South Africa's governing party keeps falling at the local level, so the country's largest cities now face coalition rule instead of one-party rule.
entries.headline: 南非地方選舉，執政黨票數再大跌

entries.angle: A home-and-national-spotlight lens: after proving themselves against the champion on the road, the first-place Bears must win the kind of home prime-time game good teams are expected to win, against a losing team whose defence just pitched a shutout.
entries.headline: 熊隊今晚主場迎戰海盜隊

entries.angle: Day-one answer to the 6 Nov trap-game preview and the 7 Nov Saliba-return entry: whether the leaders avoided the dropped points that end title runs, and whether Saliba actually made his comeback.
entries.headline: 兵工廠1比0小勝赫爾城

entries.angle: Frankfurt's own outlook and next move, distinct from the Fed (Oct 29) and Bank of England (Nov 6) decisions already covered.
entries.headline: 歐洲央行：物價還會高一陣子

entries.angle: The first American pope makes the visit to Argentina his Argentine predecessor never made, challenging Milei's austerity economics to his face.
entries.headline: 教宗到阿根廷：人比經濟重要

entries.angle: China formalizes the September truce extension — pausing the extra 24% tariff on US goods until Jan 10, 2027, effective Nov 10 — distinct from the earlier (incorrect) 'deadline tomorrow' framing that was dropped after verification.
entries.headline: 中國再停對美加稅兩個月

entries.angle: The answer to the Nov 8 preview: the first-place Bears survive a 4-turnover game to beat a team they were expected to beat, extending their win streak to four and improving to 7-2.
entries.headline: 熊隊最後一秒險勝海盜

entries.angle: A new thread for the paper: the world's climate summit opens with its organisers saying openly that it is about paying for and carrying out old promises, not making new ones, under an unusual split arrangement where one country hosts and another chairs.
entries.headline: 聯合國氣候大會在土耳其開幕

entries.angle: The quarterback experiment the paper has followed since 21 October (Carr's promotion, then his game-winning run at Rutgers on 1 November) may be reversed: after a 15-6 rivalry loss in which the offence managed no touchdown, Whittingham weighs going back to Underwood ahead of a trip to Oregon as underdogs.
entries.headline: 密西根輸掉州內大戰，四分衛可能換人

entries.angle: Saliba's comeback, until now told through forecasts and training reports (13 Oct, 23 Oct, 7 Nov), reaches its first real match minutes in an U21 game, and the international break turns the 21 November Newcastle game into the realistic date for the defence to be whole again.
entries.headline: 薩利巴傷後第一次上場比賽
